"Everything on the plate" covers two slices of toast and one fried egg. The butter, juice, coffee, and water are not on the plate, so I left them out.

- Toast: two slices of seeded bread, about 35 g each, so 70 g and roughly 180 kcal.
- Fried egg: about 46 g and roughly 90 kcal.

Total: about 116 g and 270 kcal.
